== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English Decipher-era [[:Hear Me Baby, Hold Together|Hear Me Baby, Hold Together]] original and Errata / PC Errata articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original, Decipher Errata, and PC Errata only when those English faces exist. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged.
